verdict.rationale: First-party docs on a dedicated MCP tools page say ElevenLabs lets you connect conversational agents to external MCP servers, so agents can access and process information from those servers' data sources and tools. That covers the core of the story; the hosted MCP server for managing agents is a server-side feature and is not credited here. Missing for 10: configuration details (transports, authentication, tool approval or filtering), any documented limitations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
